notes:
Updater reliability fix.

- Check Now always performs a live feed check (status?refresh=1); a normal page load shows the cache and refreshes it in the background, with a 'Feed last checked' line and a warning when the server could not be reached. A previous release can no longer be shown as the latest one.
- Online checks now use a 12s timeout with one retry and a cache-buster (raw.githubusercontent serves max-age=300).
- Download re-reads the feed first, validates asset size and SHA-256, and progress is matched to the current download.
- Install & Restart now hands off to a detached runner that waits for the app to exit, installs with /LOG and /CLOSEAPPLICATIONS /FORCECLOSEAPPLICATIONS /NOCANCEL, and relaunches the app whether the install succeeded or failed.
- Installer: removed the AppMutex that silently cancelled updates and the InitializeSetup taskkill that raced the updater's shutdown; added SetupLogging, CloseApplications, and a legacy silent relaunch entry so clients on older builds also come back up.
- New diagnostics panel in Data Management > Software Update: install folder (+ writability), last setup exit code, installer log tail.
